Player impressions:
Hoyos - came up with some good saves and clearances at important moments
Báez - his good moments are outweighing his bad
Berrocal - nothing flashing, but is clearing the ball when needed.  good job
Mihaj - ok tonight.  I'd give the edge to Berrocal.  Came off injured.
Jacob - I thought he was doing well along the right.  But when he was replaced, Atlanta then had control of that side.
Fortune - outstanding in all aspects.  controlled the midfield.  Showed up in unexpected places.  His vision on passes was top class.  Oh, and the goal.
Reilly - He needs to be putting in some better performances
Muyumba - really good to stop breakaways.  Distribution needs work
Galarza - grew into the game.  Really should have had yellows for a large number of fouls.
Miranchuk - Good distribution tonight.  Poor shots.  
Saba - good going down the right.  Better crosses than earlier this season.  His shots were poor, and should have put Atlanta ahead.
Picault - better than those he replaces on the left.  At his age, needs to spend more time recouping or he may not be able to regain those heights
Edwards - really good play tonight.  More as a winger than defender.
Gregersen - did what he had to do
Latte Lath - I honestly forgot he was on the pitch for a stretch.  His defensive play is better than his offensive.
Togashi - gets in good spots, but looks out of sorts on the shots.  Like he's thinking too much.  A shame as he's probably putting himself out of contention.
